industry: Uranium Mining and Nuclear Fuel Services
thesis: Cameco is the largest Western-listed uranium producer and the only company spanning the full non-Russian nuclear fuel cycle at scale: tier-one Saskatchewan mines, the world's largest commercial uranium refinery and Canada's only UF6 conversion plant, and a 49% stake in Westinghouse whose AP1000 is the only fully licensed and deployed Gen III+ reactor. The uranium long-term contract price set a nominal record of $96.50/lb in August 2026 and has not fallen in a single month since July 2025, yet the stock is flat over a year and 36% below its high because 2026 deliveries were deliberately held low and Westinghouse equity earnings lapped a one-off Dukovany project contribution. The debate is the Westinghouse mark: Bloomberg reports a US listing targeting over $50B (a $24.5B look-through stake against a $38B market cap) while Korean press implies $15-20B, and a registration statement could land in October 2026.

drivers: Westinghouse IPO prices at or above the reported US$50B valuation, validating a $24.5B look-through value for Cameco's 49% stake bought for US$2.1B in 2023
Definitive AP1000 orders convert from the DOE's US$17.5B conditional loan commitment for up to 10 US reactors, the Korean six-reactor discussions, or the July 2026 US-Saudi 123 agreement
Long-term uranium pushes above $100/lb from the record $96.50/lb August 2026 close, repricing the least-committed 2029-2030 delivery years
Uranium plus fuel services adjusted EBITDA scales toward C$2.5B as market-related contract pricing catches up to spot and term levels
Cigar Lake ownership consolidation and Westinghouse eVinci/AP300 small-reactor milestones add incremental value

base_case.assumptions: Long-term uranium holds $95/lb or better, 2026 production lands inside the 19.5-21.5M lb guidance despite the Saskatchewan flooding and unplanned outages, uranium segment adjusted EBITDA grows at a high-single-digit pace as realized prices catch up to contract terms, and Westinghouse lists at a US$30-40B valuation — a real step up from the US$2.1B cost basis without validating the $50B headline. Straddles the S&P Global consensus target of $127.77 from 21 analysts and sits below MarketBeat's $148.68 average from 17 analysts.

risks: Westinghouse prices near the Korea Economic Daily implied US$15-20B valuation, or the IPO is shelved, removing the option value the bull case depends on
AP1000 opportunities stay a 91-project pipeline rather than a contracted backlog; DOE financing is not a signed reactor order
Recurring northern Saskatchewan disruptions at Key Lake, McArthur River and Cigar Lake force a 2026 production guidance cut on an already weak tape
Valuation compresses toward the GuruFocus GF Value of $68.24 from 61x forward earnings and 97x free cash flow
Uranium term prices stall as utilities step back, leaving Cameco's contracting discipline uncompensated

catalysts.event: Westinghouse public registration statement possible, per Bloomberg's 18 September 2026 report of a US listing targeting over US$50B — would disclose standalone financials and potentially contracted backlog
Q3 2026 results — first test of whether second-half production recovers ground lost to spring flooding and unplanned outages at Key Lake, McArthur River and Cigar Lake
UxC and TradeTech month-end long-term uranium price prints; the benchmark closed August 2026 at a record $96.50/lb and has not declined in any month since July 2025
Remaining JV Inkai purchase allocation delivery — majority of Cameco's 4.2M lb 2026 share expected before year end, with only 0.8M lb received in H1
FY2026 results and 2027 guidance, including production, delivery volumes and average realized price outlook
Definitive AP1000 reactor order tied to the DOE programme, the Korean US investment package or the US-Saudi 123 civil-nuclear agreement — highest-impact catalyst in the set

key_risks: Valuation offers no margin of safety at roughly 61x forward earnings, 152x trailing P/E and 97x price to free cash flow
Westinghouse valuation is a genuine binary with published marks spanning US$15-50B, a 2.5x spread on the single most important number in the thesis

Equity-method Westinghouse earnings swung to a C$56M first-half 2026 net loss on Cameco's share versus C$64M of earnings a year earlier, and the accounting opacity depresses the multiple the market will pay

Recurring operational risk in northern Saskatchewan — spring flooding, road closures and unplanned disruptions at all three core operations occurred in 2026 while guidance was maintained, loading the second half
Contracting discipline depresses near-term deliveries and earnings; Q2 2026 adjusted EPS of C$0.18 missed the C$0.38 consensus by more than half
Thin, opaque, contract-negotiated uranium market where spot is up only ~7% year over year despite record term pricing, and miner equities have de-rated far more than the commodity
JV Inkai exposes Cameco to Kazakh jurisdiction and export logistics; normalisation of Russian enrichment supply would compress the Western scarcity premium
CAD-reporting issuer with USD-traded shares adds a translation layer to every comparison; technical posture is weak with price below both the 50-day ($94.79) and 200-day ($105.79) averages
